address: 10 place de la Bourse, Bordeaux, 33000, France
bio: In the central edifice of Bordeaux’ iconic Place de la Bourse, the 1544 shines the spotlight on regional produce that is supplied by the farm of the same name at St Loubès. Elegant, flavoursome food, such as leeks in a herby dressing, free-range poultry flanked by a delectable mushroom tartlet or a citrus fruit meringue and chantilly delight to finish on a sweet yet refreshing note. The quintessentially chic interior with tasteful grey-green wainscoting and comfy armchairs is tastefully paired with slick, professional service. Love at first bite in this establishment that is the perfect marriage between old and new....
